intended_behavior: Implement concurrency control in invoke_async to detect if an invocation is already running on the same Agent instance. If so, immediately raise a concurrency exception to prevent state corruption from concurrent calls. Otherwise, mark the invocation as active during execution and clear the active status after completion or error. This will safeguard the agent’s internal state and preserve the existing asynchronous invocation behavior.

Initialize concurrency control primitives such as an async lock or atomic boolean flag to track whether an invocation is active. This supports the concurrency checks and exceptions in invoke_async, preserving other initialization functionality.
